audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no real cooldown number (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and the Trample (E) auto-attack-reset burst tell from missingInteractions was never stated anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Alistar's E Trample stacks and its 5th auto-attack reset is the actual tell that his stun combo is about to land; without a number/tell a reader can't time the disengage.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns with Headbutt (W) 14/13/12/11/10s, Trample (E) 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s plus the auto-reset tell, and R 120/100/80s.

edits.before: No new ult — press the early lead; scaling supports are waking up behind you.
edits.after: R Unbreakable Will comes online (120/100/80s CD) and tanks your poke while cleansing your root, guaranteeing his W-Q pick.

edits.before: First item: RQ chunks and RE engages — convert to plates and picks now.
edits.after: With R and first item up, one Headbutt-Pulverize connects for a kill — your Focused Resolve root is too slow to beat his flash-W range.

edits.before: Late Karma enables: RE the engage, tether the diver, RQ the sieges.
edits.after: He's a near-unkillable engage tank under R who walks through your poke — play max range and lean on Mantra-E disengage, not trades.

edits.before: RQ the carry at wave contact, tether the answer, walk — the chip leads the lane's ledger.
edits.after: Cast Focused Resolve the instant he commits Headbutt (14-10s CD) — the root holds through Pulverize and turns his combo into a dead cast.

edits.before: Spending mantra on a wave while the enemy banks theirs for your face.
edits.after: His Passive Triumphant Roar heals him and nearby allies whenever his CC lands, so an even-HP trade quietly refills his bar while yours doesn't.

edits.before: - Alistar Headbutt: matchup-defining — The headbutt-pulverize combo starts every play — respect flash range while it is up. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep RE shield-speed banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Headbutt (W) is 14/13/12/11/10s and opens every all-in — respect flash range while it's up; a whiffed cast is a free window. - Trample (E) cycles in 12-10s and its auto-reset is the burst tell — step back on the wind-up, not the cast. - R Unbreakable Will is 120/100/80s; bank Mantra-E for the fight he commits it to.

notes: phases[].rating left unchanged (7/10 for 0-3, 6/10 for 4-6) since the magnitude of advantage in the why text supports the same numbers on the corrected side. suspectNames flagged 'Hold Focused Resolve' as a possible bad name but it is Karma's real W name — false positive, no action taken.
